Definition: a Sukathite or descendant of an unknown Israelite named Sukah
BiblicalUsage: The Suchathites are named once, among the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites, these are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab. A family of scribes, counted among the Kenites.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the one line keeps a family of writers in the record, and the scribes who dwelt at Jabez are not forgotten.
